Sub: 
Audio Recording of Earnings Call with respect to Financial Results for the second 
quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 
 
Dear Sir, 
 
This is with reference to the Company intimation dated 16th October, 2026 filed with the stock 
exchanges in terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 regarding the conference call to discuss the financial results for the second 
quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 scheduled for 22nd October, 2026 at 4:15 pm 
(IST). 
 
In this regard please note that the Audio Recording of the Earnings Call can be accessed at 
https://havells.com/media/custom/corporateform/e/a/earnings_call_recording_q2_fy27.mp3  
 
The same is also available on the website of the Company under Financials in the Investors section. 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
for Havells India Limited 
 
 
 
(Sanjay Kumar Gupta) 
Company Secretary 
 
SANJAY
